name: todo-app
description: Todo App: npm workspaces monorepo (contract, api, web, e2e)

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/contract && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/contract && npm run test -w packages/contract && npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.test:int: npm run build -w packages/contract && npm run test:int -w apps/api
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w packages/contract && node e2e/run.ts
scripts.lint: npm run build -w packages/contract && eslint . && prettier --check . && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w packages/contract && concurrently -k -n contract,api "npm run dev -w packages/contract" "npm run dev -w apps/api"
